specs.description: Reference run with no parameter changes; serves as the comparison anchor for the other ablations.
specs.name: baseline

specs.description: Reliability bins computed with 5 bins instead of the configured default.
specs.name: calibration_bins_5

specs.description: Execution-aware sensitivity reported with a single 0 bps cost level so the net signal proxy equals the gross proxy.
specs.name: cost_0bps

specs.description: Execution-aware sensitivity reported with a single 1 bps cost level under explicit cost assumptions.
specs.name: cost_1bps

specs.description: SSL pretraining + fine-tuning ablation status report; always skipped because the paper runner does not yet support a traceable SSL training path.
specs.name: ssl_pretraining_ablation
specs.skip_reason: no traceable runner support for SSL pretraining/fine-tuning yet; ssl_transformer is not registered in the paper-runner model registry

specs.description: Reliability bins computed with 10 bins so the bin resolution can be compared against coarser settings.
specs.name: calibration_bins_10

specs.description: Execution-aware sensitivity with a single 0-row latency assumption.
specs.name: latency_0

specs.description: Execution-aware sensitivity with a 1-row latency assumption: realised proxy returns are pessimistically shifted by one row.
specs.name: latency_1

specs.description: Horizon override to 50 with label column label_50; labels are regenerated by the runner from the supplied frame and the temporal split is preserved.
specs.name: horizon_50

specs.description: Neural lookback window of 2 rows; applies only to neural paper-runner models that consume windows.
specs.name: lookback_2

specs.description: Neural lookback window of 4 rows; applies only to neural paper-runner models that consume windows.
specs.name: lookback_4

specs.description: Feature subset restricted to top-of-book price and quantity columns through deterministic column-name patterns; preprocessing remains fit on train rows only.
specs.name: feature_top_of_book

specs.description: Feature subset restricted to imbalance and microprice columns through column-name patterns. Skipped when too few matching columns exist on the supplied data.
specs.name: feature_imbalance

specs.description: Feature subset restricted to depth and liquidity columns (bid/ask quantity levels) through column-name patterns.
specs.name: feature_depth_liquidity
